That's the classic background-attachment: fixed problem — good news is you already added the fix for it earlier, so let's check why it might not be taking effect.

background-attachment: fixed is broken/inconsistent on mobile browsers, especially iOS Safari — sometimes it doesn't scroll at all, sometimes it causes janky/stuttery scrolling, sometimes the whole section feels "stuck" until you scroll hard enough to clear it. This is a well-known mobile limitation, not something specific to your code.

column1: The extra bit here: height: 100vh on mobile can also cause a related-but-different symptom — mobile browsers resize their address bar as you scroll, so 100vh doesn't always mean "exactly one screen," and sometimes causes extra blank space or awkward jumps. Switching to height: auto + a fixed min-height on mobile avoids that entirely, letting the section size itself to its content instead of fighting the viewport.
